purpose: Cross-compile platform-neutral modern product/title translation units with devkitA64 before linking guest simulation or a Switch host adapter.

excluded_adapters.reason: Desktop SNESRecomp host adapter: owns SDL focus/quit/pref-path and SnesDesktop display/output API binding.
Mixed title/runtime adapter: reusable course-materialization helpers share one translation unit with direct common_rtl.h/generated-runtime binding.

acceptance: every manifest translation unit exists and remains outside excluded host adapters
portable translation units do not directly include desktop/ or call SDL_/SnesDesktop APIs
every manifest portable translation unit compiles to a Switch AArch64 object with __SWITCH__ defined
no guest ROM, generated SNESRecomp code, or Switch-specific simulation fork is required
